summary: Chat through another device's AI model
hint: Run this computer's chat, request triage, and safety check on a model that runs on another OpenPal device — handy for a model too big for this computer. One engine at a time: while connected, this computer's own model isn't used.

manual.hint: On the other device, turn on Settings → Devices → Remote access, then press "Add a device" to get its address, port, and code.

engine.stopped: No model is loaded on the other device.
engine.failed: The other device's engine needs attention.
engine.unreachable: Can't reach {{name}} — chat will resume when it's back.
engine.unpaired: The other device ended this connection.
